name: TORUS
model_likelihood: Locus-specific multiple-SNP linear regression for a quantitative trait.
prior: Independent binary SNP inclusion indicators with annotation-dependent logistic probabilities and enrichment coefficients alpha.
inference_algorithm: Empirical Bayes EM: approximate SNP PIPs in the E-step; logistic regression on PIPs in the M-step; restrict model enumeration to at most K QTNs (K = 1 in practice).
estimand: Posterior locus-null probabilities for QTL discovery; enrichment coefficients and annotation-informed SNP priors.
data_input: Single-SNP association summary statistics sufficient to compute Bayes factors for K = 1; locus membership and SNP annotations.
tunable_settings: FDR target alpha (typically 0.05); truncation level K (1 in practice); annotation features and binning.
